## What the chronicles say [Record]

Established on the Council of Constance's directions on 24 October 1417, seat [Medininkai](../places/medininkai.qmd) (Varniai from 1470); first bishop Matthias of Trakai (Motiejus Trakiškis, 1417-22), later bishop of Vilnius (en.wikipedia, Samogitian Diocese). It finishes the Samogitian baptism begun after [Horodło](ev_horodlo.qmd).

## What really happened [Saga]

The saga makes it the end of the Hidden Groves, the gods' last foothold bought by Birutė's sacrifice (D7): the bell over the stumps, Eglė's snake gone white, the Root-Mother put to sleep (Book IV ch. 7, ch. 27).

## Consequences

The mirror of [Horodło](ev_horodlo.qmd): the baptism begun in 1413 is completed.

## Dramatisation

Book IV ch. 7 *Medininkų vyskupija* (autumn 1417; Medininkai, Samogitia).
